label: CSV
description: CSV files (RFC 4180: a header row, comma-separated fields, quotes around fields that need them) read as rows of a declared shape, and rows written as a file. The file is streamed both ways; only the rows are values.

parse.description: Read a CSV blob as a list of rows. The header row names the columns; each following row becomes one value of `type`, its number and boolean fields coerced from text, judged against the shape. An empty cell of an optional field is absent. A row that does not fit the shape fails the node with its line number.

type.description: the shape of one row; its fields are the columns read

write.description: Write rows as a CSV blob: a header row of the shape's fields in declared order, then one line per row, quoting what needs it. Answers the new file's handle.

type.description: the shape of one row; its fields are the columns written

filename.description: the name the file is offered under when downloaded
